articles.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
articles.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.
articles.titleJa: リンゼイ・クランシー殺人事件で陪審が膠着状態に陥り、審理無効が宣言される
articles.summary: リンゼイ・クランシーが3人の子供の死に対し刑事責任を問われるか不透明になり、殺人事件は宙に浮いた状態にある。

articles.title: US envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
articles.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are due to hold talks with Russia before travelling to Ukraine on Sunday.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ協議を前に、米国特使がモスクワに到着
articles.summary: スティーブ・ウィットコフとジャレッド・クシュナーは、ウクライナ訪問前にロシアと会談する予定だ。

articles.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
articles.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.
articles.titleJa: ヨーロッパで横行する破壊工作、ロシアが主要な容疑者
articles.summary: ドイツはライプチヒ空港への攻撃でロシアを非難しており、欧州各地で一連の不審な事件が発生している。

articles.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
articles.description: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.
articles.titleJa: ネパールで救助隊がトンネルに閉じ込められた数十人に到達を試みる、2人を発見
articles.summary: 1,300人以上が死亡、数千人が行方不明の中、トンネル内で生存者が見つかり、救助隊の希望が高まっている。

articles.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
articles.description: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.
articles.titleJa: トランプ大統領、ハイイロオオカミの絶滅危惧種保護を解除する命令に署名
articles.summary: 米大統領は農場主を助けると言うが、環境保護論者は個体数回復の努力を妨げると主張している。

articles.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
articles.description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.
articles.titleJa: 国連、アフリカの真の大きさを反映する新世界地図の採択を採択
articles.summary: トーゴが提出した決議は164カ国に支持され、米国は唯一反対票を投じた。

articles.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
articles.description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
articles.titleJa: ドイツの極右AfD、東部での選挙で初の権力掌握を目指す
articles.summary: ザクセン＝アンハルト州で絶対多数を獲得すれば、第二次世界大戦後初めて極右政党がドイツの州レベルで政権を握ることになる。

articles.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
articles.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.
articles.titleJa: ボリビア軍兵舎での爆発で少なくとも2人死亡
articles.summary: ビアチャでの死者数が増えることが懸念されており、当局はさらなる爆発の危険があるため兵舎から離れるよう警告している。

articles.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
articles.description: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.
articles.titleJa: ゼレンスキー大統領、ロシアがドローン攻撃でウクライナ保安庁本部を攻撃と発表
articles.summary: 無人航空機がウクライナの首都中心部を警告なしに攻撃した。

articles.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
articles.description: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.
articles.titleJa: 「まれな喜びの瞬間」：ネパールのトンネル救助が洪水生存者への希望をもたらす
articles.summary: トリシュリ川沿いのトンネル網には、まだ数百人の作業員が閉じ込められているが、救助活動に希望が見える。

articles.title: Russia announces three-day halt in strikes as Trump envoys visit for Ukraine talks
articles.description: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff have reportedly arrived in Moscow to revive Ukraine peace talks. The trip is the pair's first visit to Kyiv since US President Donald Trump's reelection.
articles.titleJa: ロシアが3日間の攻撃停止を発表、トランプ特使がウクライナ和平交渉のため訪問
articles.summary: トランプ特使がウクライナ和平交渉のためモスクワを訪れ、ロシアは3日間の攻撃停止を発表した。特使らはトランプ氏再選後、初のキーウ訪問となる。

articles.title: Iran war: Explosions reported near Kharg Island
articles.description: Iranian media has reported that a tanker was targeted near the oil hub of Kharg Island. DW has the latest.
articles.titleJa: イラン戦争：ハルグ島付近で爆発が報告される
articles.summary: イランの報道によると、石油ハブであるハルグ島付近でタンカーが標的にされ、爆発が報告された。DWが最新情報を伝えている。

articles.title: Germany: From emigration to immigration destination
articles.description: Migration is a sensitive topic in Germany, with public debate dominated by the fear of uncontrolled immigration. But over two centuries, millions of Germans emigrated in search of a better life.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ：移民流出国から移住先へ
articles.summary: 移民問題はドイツでデリケートな話題であり、不法移民への懸念が公共議論を支配している。しかし、2世紀以上にわたり、何百万ものドイツ人がより良い生活を求めて移住してきた。

articles.title: Why many Syrians feel Assad's death sentence isn't enough
articles.description: In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. But after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are demanding more when it comes to transitional justice.
articles.titleJa: なぜ多くのシリア人がアサドへの死刑判決では不十分だと感じるのか
articles.summary: シリアの裁判所は元独裁者アサドに死刑を宣告したが、14年間の内戦後も多くの生存者は、移行期の正義に関してさらなる措置を求めている。

articles.title: India news: 275 Indians still missing in Nepal floods
articles.description: Official estimates say that 275 Indians continue to be unaccounted for in Nepal's flood catastrophe. Meanwhile, no Indian travelers are said to be stranded in flood-affected Tibet. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: インドニュース：ネパール洪水でインド人275人が依然行方不明
articles.summary: 公式推計によると、ネパールの洪水災害でインド人275人の行方が依然として不明である。チベットではインド人旅行者の立ち往生は報告されていない。

articles.title: Germany news: Thousands expected at Saxony-Anhalt rallies
articles.description: Ahead of Saxony-Anhalt's state election on Sunday, a democracy festival by civil society groups is planned in Magdeburg. The far-right AfD will also hold its final campaign rally in the state capital. DW has the latest.
articles.titleJa: ドイツニュース：ザクセン＝アンハルト州の集会に数千人が参加予定
articles.summary: ザクセン＝アンハルト州議会選挙を前に、市民団体による民主主義フェスティバルがマグデブルクで計画され、極右政党AfDも最終的な選挙集会を開催する。

articles.title: What would an AfD government in Saxony-Anhalt really mean?
articles.description: Detention centers for deportation, mandatory work for asylum-seekers, vigilante groups — the AfD wants to drastically overhaul Saxony-Anhalt. What does the party have planned?
articles.titleJa: ザクセン＝アンハルト州でAfD政権が誕生した場合、実際に何を意味するのか？
articles.summary: 難民収容所、亡命希望者への強制労働、自警団など、AfDはザクセン＝アンハルト州を劇的に改革しようとしている。その具体的な政策内容と影響について分析する。

articles.title: Tunisia: Judge orders arrest of journalist Mohamed Yousfi
articles.description: A journalist and vocal critic of the Tunisian president, Mohamed Yousfi has been taken into custody ahead of an interview. A union called the arrest an attack on all journalists' rights.
articles.titleJa: チュニジア：判事がジャーナリスト、モハメド・ユースフィ氏の逮捕を命令
articles.summary: チュニジア大統領の批判者であるジャーナリスト、モハメド・ユースフィ氏がインタビューを前に拘束された。労働組合は今回の逮捕を全てのジャーナリストの権利への攻撃だと非難している。

articles.title: Bolivia: Deadly explosion rocks military base in Viacha
articles.description: The explosion occurred at an army base where fireworks were stored. The exact cause of the blast is under investigation.
articles.titleJa: ボリビア：ビアチャの軍事基地で致命的な爆発が発生
articles.summary: 花火が保管されていた陸軍基地で爆発が発生し、死者が出た。爆発の正確な原因は現在調査中である。

articles.title: UN approves world map reflecting true size of Africa
articles.description: The UN General Assembly voted to adopt a map that more accurately shows the size of the continents. Only the United States voted against the measure, which projects the country as smaller than on traditional maps.
articles.titleJa: 国連、アフリカの真の大きさを反映した世界地図を承認
articles.summary: 国連総会は大陸の真の大きさをより正確に示す地図の採用を可決した。この措置に反対したのはアメリカ合衆国のみである。

articles.title: UN votes to adopt new world map that shows Africa’s true scale
articles.description:
Togo-sponsored resolution called to phase out traditional map that depicts continent as similar size to Greenland
The United Nations has voted to adopt a resolution for the world to formally phase out the traditional Mercator map of the globe in favour of one that more accurately displays Africa’s size.
In a session at its headquarters in New York, the UN general assembly officially retired the 16th-century Mercator projection in favour of one based on the more accurate 2018 Equal Earth design.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 国連、アフリカの真の規模を示す新世界地図の採用を投票で決定
articles.summary: 国連は、アフリカの真の規模を示す「Equal Earth」世界地図の採用を決定。従来のメルカトル図法を廃止し、より正確な地球の姿を提示する。

articles.title: Spain’s PM says no evidence ‘whatsoever’ Morocco behind Ceuta border breach
articles.description:
Pedro Sánchez continues to defend Rabat after police report claiming border forces helped 70,000 cross border

Europe live – latest updates

Spain has seen no evidence “whatsoever” that Morocco planned or facilitated a mass border breach into its north African territory of Ceuta, the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has told parliament.
The address on Thursday followed the emergence of a police report, commissioned by a judge and widely quoted in the media, claiming Moroccan border forces had actively aided about 70,000 people to cross the border in late July.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: スペイン首相、セウタ国境侵犯事件でモロッコ関与の証拠「全くない」と発言
articles.summary: スペイン首相は、セウタ国境侵犯でモロッコ関与の証拠「全くない」と議会で発言。警察報告がモロッコの支援を示唆する中、同国を擁護した。

articles.title: ‘We continue to suffer’: victims of apartheid-era Sharpeville massacre demand compensation
articles.description:
Claim relating to 1960 attack on hundreds of protesters part of wave of litigation over apartheid crimes in South Africa
The day dawned brightly on 21 March 1960, as residents of the South African township of Sharpeville gathered to protest against pass laws, which forced “Black, Indian and Coloured” South Africans to carry documents at all times specifying where they were allowed to be.
Abraham Mofokeng joined the march, one of dozens organised nationwide by the Pan Africanist Congress (PAC), a breakaway group from the African National Congress (ANC). “The weather was very nice, the sun was out. You could not have suspected that the day would go so horribly,” said Mofokeng, who was then a 20-year-old factory worker.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「私たちは苦しみ続けている」：アパルトヘイト時代のシャープビル虐殺の犠牲者が賠償を要求
articles.summary: 南アフリカのアパルトヘイト時代のシャープビル虐殺犠牲者が、政府に賠償を要求。1960年の事件への歴史的な不正義の是正を求める訴訟の一部だ。

articles.title: New constitution in Guinea-Bissau will undermine democracy, opponents say
articles.description:
Referendum result means fewer seats in parliament and new rules on candidates, ahead of December elections
Guinea-Bissau voters have approved a new constitution, which critics say will undermine democracy, that significantly expands presidential powers ahead of elections due in December.
According to provisional results, 70% of voters approved sweeping changes in the tiny west African state’s first constitutional amendment since revisions that ended the one-party socialist state more than three decades ago.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ギニアビサウの新憲法は民主主義を損なうだろう、と反対派が指摘
articles.summary: ギニアビサウで新憲法が承認されたが、反対派は民主主義を損ない大統領権限を拡大すると批判。12月の選挙を前に、国の将来に大きな影響を与えるだろう。

articles.title: Almost half of world’s farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
articles.description:
Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities
Almost half of the world’s farmers are poisoned by pesticides every single year, a study has found.
Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network, found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 専門家が発表：世界の農民のほぼ半数が毎年農薬中毒に
articles.summary: 専門家調査で、世界の農民のほぼ半数にあたる年間約4億人が農薬中毒に苦しんでいることが判明。年間1万1千人が死亡し、その6割近くがインドに集中している。

articles.title: ‘It cost me many friendships’: former Brazil military chief reveals inside struggle to stop Bolsonaro’s coup
articles.description:
Carlos de Almeida Baptista Júnior describes 2022 meeting in new book as ex-leader’s son vies with Lula for presidency
The far-right populist Jair Bolsonaro was in his final days as Brazil’s president when, six weeks after losing the election and still refusing to recognise the result, he summoned the heads of the armed forces to a meeting.
The defence minister, Gen Paulo Sérgio Nogueira de Oliveira, took out a document from a plastic folder and handed copies to the commanders of the navy, army and air force.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「多くの友情を失った」：元ブラジル軍参謀長、ボルソナーロのクーデター阻止の内幕を明かす
articles.summary: 元ブラジル軍参謀長が、ボルソナーロ前大統領のクーデター阻止の内部闘争を新著で明かす。2022年の選挙敗北後、軍幹部が召集され、クーデター計画が議論されたという。

articles.title: Trump’s ‘retribution’ could now include Falklands as favor to Milei – and revenge on the UK
articles.description:
US president suggests he might support his Argentinian acolyte’s drive to reclaim sovereignty of disputed islands
Donald Trump has long embraced vengeance. “I am your retribution,” he declared to an admiring audience at the 2023 Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) as he commenced his march back to the White House.
It is unlikely Argentina, and far-flung holdovers of the former British empire, were on the US president’s mind at the time.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏の「報復」は、ミレイ氏への便宜としてフォークランド諸島問題を含む可能性 – そして英国への報復
articles.summary: トランプ氏が、ミレイ氏への便宜としてフォークランド諸島問題でアルゼンチン支持を検討する可能性が浮上。英国への報復とも解釈され、米外交政策に影響を与えうる。

articles.title: Colombia president provokes disgust by posing with bodies of ‘terrorists’
articles.description:
Abelardo De La Espriella posts video of himself with rows of body bags as performative populism continues to sweep Americas
Colombia’s hardline president, Abelardo De La Espriella, has provoked outrage after posting a video on social media in which he strides through rows of white body bags that he says contained the corpses of 23 “neutralised” guerrillas.
De La Espriella took power last month vowing “all-out war” against illegal armed groups and he published the footage on Thursday in an apparent attempt to show he was fulfilling that pledge.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コロンビア大統領、「テロリスト」の遺体とポーズを取り嫌悪感を引き起こす
articles.summary: コロンビア大統領が、「無力化された」ゲリラの遺体とポーズを取る動画をSNSに投稿し、国民の嫌悪感を招いた。これは、同氏の「全面戦争」公約履行のアピールと見られる。

articles.title: Javier Milei: ‘winds of change’ support Argentina’s claim to Falkland Islands
articles.description:
President cites Trump’s suggestion that he might reconsider US stance on British sovereignty and threatens swifter sanctions on UK oil interests
President Javier Milei has said “winds of change” favourable to Argentina’s claim to the Falkland Islands are blowing around the world in a televised address, citing signs that Donald Trump may reconsider the US position on the islands’ sovereignty.
“Recently, President Trump declared that the US is re-evaluating its historic position in relation to the Malvinas,” he said, using the Argentinian name for the islands.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ハビエル・ミレイ氏：「変化の風」がアルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島領有権主張を支持
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領は、トランプ氏の米国の立場見直し示唆を挙げ、「変化の風」がフォークランド諸島領有権主張を支持するとテレビ演説で述べた。

articles.title: UK hits back at Argentinian Falklands claim and insists islands remain British
articles.description:
Ed Miliband says Britain’s position remains ‘unwavering’ in response to remarks by Argentina’s president

UK politics live – latest updates

British ministers have hit back after the Argentinian president said “winds of change” favourable to his country’s claim to the Falklands were “blowing around the world”.
The foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, said the UK would “resolutely uphold” the self-determination of the islands after the Argentinian president, Javier Milei, said his country needed to take them back.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国、アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島主張に反撃し、諸島は英国領であると主張
articles.summary: アルゼンチン大統領のフォークランド諸島領有権主張に対し、英国は反撃し、諸島の自己決定権を「断固支持」と表明。英国の立場は「揺るぎない」と強調した。

articles.title: Two people pulled alive by Nepal's search and rescue team 10 days after devastating flash floods
articles.description: Ten days after floods devastated Nepal, one woman and one man were pulled alive on Saturday in separate search and rescue operations. Meanwhile, more than 5,000 people remain missing and at least 1,300 were killed.
articles.titleJa: ネパールを襲った壊滅的な鉄砲水から10日後、2人が救助隊によって生存確認
articles.summary: ネパールで壊滅的な鉄砲水が発生してから10日後、救助隊が男女2名を生存した状態で救出。5,000人以上が行方不明、1,300人以上が死亡している。

articles.title: Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić commemorated in Belgrade, but no state honours
articles.description: Thousands are expected at Mladić's burial in Belgrade on Monday, which will proceed without serving officials, artillery salutes or ceremonial military presence. Brussels has earlier said any glorification would be "incompatible with the values on which the EU path is built".
articles.titleJa: ボスニア系セルビア人戦犯ムラディッチがベオグラードで追悼されるも、国家栄誉はなし
articles.summary: ボスニア系セルビア人戦犯ムラディッチの葬儀がベオグラードで行われるが、公務員や軍の参加はなく、国家としての栄誉は伴わない。EUは戦犯の美化を非難している。

articles.title: 'Protest' at Port of Dover causes delays to ferry services as masked men descend on the town
articles.description: "No arrests were made. Traffic is flowing normally, and all involved had dispersed by midday," Kent police said in an update on Saturday afternoon.
articles.titleJa: ドーバー港での「抗議活動」によりフェリー運行に遅延、覆面姿の男たちが町に集結
articles.summary: ドーバー港での抗議活動によりフェリー運行に遅延が発生したが、逮捕者はなく、交通は正常に戻ったとケント警察が発表した。

articles.title: Health warnings could reduce youth’s hours spent on social media
articles.description: Pop-up messages that warn of the harms of social media could help reduce youth’s social media use, a new study found.
articles.titleJa: 健康警告は若者のソーシャルメディア利用時間を減らす可能性がある
articles.summary: 新しい研究によると、ソーシャルメディアの害を警告するポップアップメッセージが、若者のソーシャルメディア利用時間を減らすのに役立つ可能性がある。

articles.title: IFA 2026: Looking beyond the smart home with Haier
articles.description: From AI-powered appliances to humanoid robots, Haier is using IFA 2026 to showcase its vision of the "intelligent home". Euronews spoke to Haier Europe CEO Neil Tunstall about what comes after the smart home — and how soon some of these ideas could become reality.
articles.titleJa: IFA 2026：Haierがスマートホームのその先を見据える
articles.summary: HaierはIFA 2026で、AI家電から人型ロボットまで、「インテリジェントホーム」の未来像を披露。スマートホームの次の段階と実現時期を議論する。

articles.title: Iranian media report US strike on Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island
articles.description: Iranian media reported that an Iranian oil tanker was struck by US forces on Saturday morning, a day after Iran reportedly fired missiles towards the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.titleJa: イランメディア、ハルグ島沖でイランの石油タンカーが米軍に攻撃されたと報じる
articles.summary: イランメディアは、ハルグ島沖でイランの石油タンカーが米軍によって攻撃されたと報じた。これはイランがホルムズ海峡に向けてミサイルを発射した翌日のことだ。

articles.title: Three killed in Israeli strikes on Lebanon, health ministry says
articles.description: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said it had targeted Hezbollah infrastructure in southern Lebanon "in response to Hezbollah’s attempted attack yesterday against IDF troops operating in the security zone."
articles.titleJa: レバノンでイスラエル軍の攻撃により3人死亡、保健省が発表
articles.summary: レバノン南部でイスラエル軍の攻撃により3人が死亡したと保健省が発表。イスラエル国防軍は、ヒズボラの攻撃未遂への報復としてインフラを標的としたと説明。

articles.title: Final sprint before Saxony-Anhalt vote: AfD campaigns at 'family festival' in Magdeburg
articles.description: Ulrich Siegmund could lead the AfD in Saxony-Anhalt into government, marking the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany's post-war era.
articles.titleJa: ザクセン＝アンハルト州選挙前の最終局面：AfDがマグデブルクで「家族祭り」でキャンペーン
articles.summary: ドイツのザクセン＝アンハルト州で選挙が迫る中、極右政党AfDが戦後ドイツで初めて州レベルの政権を握る可能性があり、活発なキャンペーンを展開中だ。

articles.title: Boss of STIHL: Time for reforms – this is how we will safe prosperity and welfare state

articles.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels

In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
